STANZA I
Blest is the man, for ever blest
Blest is the man, for ever blest,
Whose guilt is pardon'd by his God,
Whose sins with sorrow are confess'd,
And cover'd with his Saviour's blood.
The psalm it sets
Watts made this hymn from Psalm 32, "in the language of the New Testament": a paraphrase, not a translation. The line that comes closest to it is marked.

Blest is the man to whom the Lord Imputes not his iniquities, He pleads no merit of reward, And not on works, but grace relies. STANZA II
Its place in the book
